limitations_and_boundaries: The study primarily uses mouse embryonic fibroblasts and human U2OS cells; generalizability to other cell types or in vivo contexts requires further investigation.
The causal link between micronuclear envelope rupture and cGAS activation is based on live-cell imaging correlations; direct perturbation of rupture is not performed.
The single-cell transcriptomics experiment has a limited sample size (32 micronucleated cells and 28 control cells).
The study does not directly demonstrate that cGAS activation by micronuclei leads to downstream interferon responses in vivo beyond correlation.
